summary: The review is well-hedged and consistent with its underlying evidence. All numeric claims (install duration 2012ms, slowest test 1777ms, peak RAM 10695475 bytes, 6/6 tests passed, 2 PARTIAL/1 UNVERIFIED claims, reproduced=true across 6 tests, 1 MEDIUM static finding) check out against final.json, replay.json, evaluation.json, and risk.json. The review correctly flags that the documented `npm install uglify-js -g` command was not run verbatim (using a source install instead) and marks that claim PARTIAL rather than PASS, and appropriately leaves the Node engine-version claim UNVERIFIED rather than inflating coverage. Score arithmetic (87 overall) matches the weighted dimension math. No exaggerated language, unsupported claims, or unfair conclusions were found; the WORTH IT verdict is proportionate to the passing tests, low setup friction, and single non-blocking static finding.
